questions.q: A train 200 m long running at 72 km/h crosses a platform 300 m long. How long does it take?
questions.exp: Speed = 20 m/s; distance = 500 m; time = 500/20 = 25 s.

questions.q: A sum amounts to Rs 11,500 in 3 years at 5% simple interest per annum. What is the principal?
Which activity is most suitable for introducing the idea of a fraction as part of a whole to Class VI learners?
options: Memorising rules for adding fractions with unlike denominators
Solving a long list of fraction problems from the textbook
Dictating the definition of a fraction to be copied down
Folding paper strips or circles into equal parts and shading some of them
questions.exp: Concrete, hands-on activities such as paper folding build conceptual understanding before symbolic rules.

questions.q: A trader buys 40 kg of rice at Rs 25/kg and 60 kg at Rs 30/kg, mixes them and sells the whole at Rs 32/kg. What is his total profit?
18 is what percent of 72?
The population of a village (in hundreds) was 40, 46, 55 and 60 in 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2022. What is the percentage increase from 2019 to 2020?
questions.exp: Increase = 6 on 40, so (6/40) x 100 = 15%.

questions.q: Milk and water are in the ratio 3 : 2 in 20 litres of a mixture. How much water must be added to make the ratio 1 : 1?
questions.exp: Milk = 12 L, water = 8 L; for 1 : 1 water must be 12 L, so add 4 L.

questions.q: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 11?
questions.exp: For 2728: (2 + 2) - (7 + 8) = -11, a multiple of 11 (2728 = 11 x 248). The others give differences -7, -2 and -3.

questions.q: A learner knows 7 x 4 = 28 but cannot find 7 x 8. Which teaching strategy best uses prior knowledge?
options: Ask the learner to memorise the whole table by rote
Tell the learner to look the answer up
Skip the topic until next year
Show that 7 x 8 is double 7 x 4, i.e. 2 x 28 = 56
questions.exp: Linking new facts to known ones (doubling) builds understanding and number sense.

questions.q: What is the largest number that divides 245 and 1029 leaving a remainder 5 in each case?
questions.exp: Required number = HCF(240, 1024) = 16.

questions.q: Which of the following is an open-ended question suitable for Class VI?
options: How many different rectangles with whole-number sides have an area of 24 square units?
questions.exp: An open-ended task has several valid answers/approaches and encourages exploration; the others have a single fixed answer.

questions.q: A rectangular tank is 5 m long, 4 m wide and 3 m deep. What is its capacity in litres?
questions.exp: Volume = 5 x 4 x 3 = 60 m³ = 60 x 1000 = 60,000 litres.

questions.q: Pipe A fills a tank in 20 minutes, pipe B in 30 minutes, and pipe C empties it in 60 minutes. If all three are open, how long to fill the tank?
The average age of 6 persons is 30 years. A new person joins and the average becomes 31 years. What is the age of the new person?
questions.exp: New total = 7 x 31 = 217; old total = 6 x 30 = 180; new person = 217 - 180 = 37.

questions.q: If 6 workers build a wall in 10 days, how many days will 4 workers (working at the same rate) take?
questions.exp: Work = 6 x 10 = 60 worker-days; days for 4 workers = 60/4 = 15 (inverse proportion).

questions.q: How many bricks of size 20 cm x 10 cm x 6 cm are needed to build a wall 12 m long, 20 cm thick and 3 m high? (ignore mortar)
questions.exp: Wall volume = 1200 x 20 x 300 = 7,200,000 cm³; brick volume = 1200 cm³; number = 7,200,000/1200 = 6000.

questions.q: What is the compound interest on Rs 8000 for 2 years at 10% per annum compounded annually?
A trader buys a table for Rs 1250 and sells it at a loss of 12%. What is the selling price?
Rs 840 is divided among three persons in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5. What is the smallest share?
questions.exp: Total parts = 12, one part = 840/12 = 70, smallest share = 3 x 70 = 210.

questions.q: A can do a job in 10 days and B in 15 days. They are paid Rs 1800 for completing it together. What is A's share?
questions.exp: Work rates are 1/10 : 1/15 = 3 : 2; A's share = 3/5 x 1800 = 1080.

questions.q: Of 70 students, 40 play cricket, 30 play football and 10 play neither. How many play both games?
questions.exp: Students playing at least one = 60; both = 40 + 30 - 60 = 10.

questions.q: What is the smallest 4-digit number divisible by 12?
A family's monthly budget is Rs 36,000. A pie chart shows 40% on food and 25% on rent. How much is spent on food and rent together?
What is the volume of a cone of base radius 6 cm and height 7 cm? (π = 22/7)
A's salary is 25% more than B's. By what percent is B's salary less than A's?
questions.exp: Let B = 100, A = 125; B is 25 less than A, and 25/125 x 100 = 20%.

questions.q: The ratio of a person's income to expenditure is 5 : 4 and his savings are Rs 4000. What is his income?
questions.exp: Savings = 1 part = 4000, so income = 5 x 4000 = 20000.

questions.q: The marked price of a shirt is Rs 900 and a discount of 15% is given. What is the selling price?
The population of a town is 20000 and grows 10% every year. What will it be after 2 years?
A sum of Rs 5000 earns a simple interest of Rs 1200 in 4 years. What is the rate of interest per annum?
Which of the following sets of sides forms a right-angled triangle?
questions.exp: 8² + 15² = 64 + 225 = 289 = 17²; the other sets fail the Pythagoras relation.

questions.q: An arc of a circle subtends an angle of 80° at the centre. What angle does it subtend at a point on the remaining part of the circle?
questions.exp: The angle at the centre is double the angle at the circumference, so 80°/2 = 40°.

questions.q: What is the volume of a cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 10 cm? (π = 22/7)
A can do a job in 10 days and B in 15 days. They work together for 3 days and then B leaves. How many more days will A alone take to finish the job?
questions.exp: In 3 days they do 3 x (1/10 + 1/15) = 3/6 = 1/2; the remaining 1/2 takes A (1/2)/(1/10) = 5 days.

questions.q: If 2x + 3y = 12 and x - y = 1, what is the value of y?
questions.exp: x = y + 1, so 2y + 2 + 3y = 12 gives y = 2 (and x = 3).

questions.q: Five students scored 45, 60, 52, 48 and 70 marks. What is the mean score?
Two trains of lengths 100 m and 140 m run in opposite directions at 40 km/h and 32 km/h. How long do they take to cross each other?
questions.exp: Relative speed = 72 km/h = 20 m/s; distance = 240 m; time = 240/20 = 12 s.

questions.q: What is the measure of each interior angle of a regular octagon?
What single discount is equivalent to two successive discounts of 10% and 20%?
questions.exp: Net price factor = 0.9 x 0.8 = 0.72, so the single discount is 28%.

questions.q: A chord 16 cm long is drawn in a circle of radius 10 cm. What is its distance from the centre?
questions.exp: Half-chord = 8; distance = √(10² - 8²) = 6 cm (perpendicular from centre bisects the chord).

questions.q: A train 150 m long runs at 54 km/h. How long does it take to pass a pole?
What is the amount on Rs 10000 at 20% per annum for 1 year, compounded half-yearly?
questions.exp: Rate per half-year = 10% for 2 periods: 10000 x 1.1 x 1.1 = 12100.

questions.q: What is the HCF of 84 and 126?
questions.exp: 84 = 2²x3x7 and 126 = 2x3²x7, so HCF = 2x3x7 = 42.

questions.q: What is the smallest number that must be added to 1000 to make it divisible by 7?
What is the amount on Rs 12000 at 5% per annum compound interest for 2 years?
If A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 5, what is A : B : C?
questions.exp: Make B equal: A:B = 8:12 and B:C = 12:15, so A:B:C = 8:12:15.

questions.q: What is the LCM of 12, 18 and 30?
A number increased by 25% becomes 150. What is the number?
In an election between two candidates, the winner got 55% of the votes and won by 3000 votes. How many votes were cast in total?
questions.exp: Margin = 55% - 45% = 10% of total = 3000, so total = 30000.

questions.q: If the side of a square is increased by 10%, by what percent does its area increase?
questions.exp: New area = (1.1)² = 1.21 of the old area, an increase of 21%.

questions.q: In an isosceles triangle the vertex angle is 40°. What is each base angle?
questions.exp: Base angles are equal: (180° - 40°)/2 = 70°.

questions.q: If x + 1/x = 3, what is x² + 1/x²?
questions.exp: Square both sides: x² + 2 + 1/x² = 9, so x² + 1/x² = 7.

questions.q: What is 35% of 640?
Which of the following sets of lengths cannot be the sides of a triangle?
questions.exp: A triangle needs the sum of any two sides to exceed the third; 5 + 7 = 12 < 13.

questions.q: What is the difference between compound interest and simple interest on Rs 5000 at 8% per annum for 2 years?
questions.exp: Difference for 2 years = P(R/100)² = 5000 x 0.0064 = 32 (CI = 832, SI = 800).

questions.q: The price of an article is increased by 20% and then the new price is decreased by 20%. What is the net change in the price?
questions.exp: Final price = 1.2 x 0.8 = 0.96 of the original, i.e. a 4% decrease.

questions.q: A school has 40 students in Class VI, 50 in VII, 60 in VIII and 50 in IX. What percent of all students are in Class VIII?
If a + b = 10 and ab = 21, what is the value of a² + b²?
A 13 m ladder leans against a wall with its foot 5 m from the wall. How high up the wall does it reach?
A boat goes 10 km/h in still water and the stream flows at 2 km/h. How long will it take to go 36 km downstream?
questions.exp: Downstream speed = 12 km/h; time = 36/12 = 3 hours.

questions.q: A cyclist rides at 16 km/h. How far will he travel in 45 minutes?
questions.exp: 45 minutes = 0.75 h; distance = 16 x 0.75 = 12 km.

questions.q: An exterior angle of a triangle is 110° and one of its interior opposite angles is 45°. What is the other interior opposite angle?
questions.exp: Exterior angle = sum of the two interior opposite angles, so the other = 110° - 45° = 65°.

questions.q: In a class of 50 students, 30 like tea, 25 like coffee and 10 like both. How many like neither?
questions.exp: Students liking at least one = 30 + 25 - 10 = 45; neither = 50 - 45 = 5.

questions.q: A man walking at 5 km/h reaches his office 12 minutes late; walking at 6 km/h he is 6 minutes early. What is the distance to the office?
A room is 8 m long, 6 m wide and 3 m high. What is the total area of its four walls?
questions.exp: Area of four walls = 2(l + b) x h = 2(8 + 6) x 3 = 84 m².

questions.q: The perimeter of a rectangle is 36 cm and its length is 10 cm. What is its area?
questions.exp: l + b = 18 so b = 8; area = 10 x 8 = 80 cm².

questions.q: How many square tiles of side 20 cm are needed to cover a floor 6 m long and 4 m wide?
questions.exp: Floor area = 600 x 400 = 240000 cm²; tile area = 400 cm²; tiles = 600.

questions.q: A shopkeeper marks goods 40% above cost price and allows a discount of 10%. What is his profit percent?
questions.exp: SP = 1.4 x 0.9 = 1.26 of CP, so profit = 26%.

questions.q: The product of two numbers is 2160 and their HCF is 12. What is their LCM?
questions.exp: HCF x LCM = product, so LCM = 2160/12 = 180.

questions.q: A student must score 40% to pass. He scored 180 marks and failed by 20 marks. What are the maximum marks?
questions.exp: Pass marks = 180 + 20 = 200 = 40% of max, so max = 500.

questions.q: The angles of a triangle are in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. What is the largest angle?
questions.exp: Sum of angles 180°; one part = 180/9 = 20°; largest = 4 x 20 = 80°.

questions.q: Simplify (x² - 9)/(x - 3) for x ≠ 3.
questions.exp: x² - 9 = (x - 3)(x + 3), so the quotient is x + 3.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a criterion for congruence of two triangles?
options: SSA (two sides and a non-included angle)
questions.exp: SSA does not guarantee congruence in general; SAS, ASA and SSS are valid criteria (RHS is valid only for right triangles).

questions.q: Which of the following is the factorisation of x² - x - 12?
How many prime numbers lie between 20 and 40?
questions.exp: The primes are 23, 29, 31 and 37, so there are 4.

questions.q: A Class VI student says 0.35 is greater than 0.4 because 35 is greater than 4. What misconception does this show?
options: Treating the decimal digits as a whole number without regard to place value
Being unable to read numbers aloud
questions.exp: The student ignores place value after the decimal point; 0.35 = 35/100 < 40/100 = 0.4.

questions.q: Solve for x: 5(x - 2) = 3x + 6.
What percent of 2 hours is 15 minutes?
What is the units digit of 3^15?
questions.exp: Units digits of powers of 3 repeat 3, 9, 7, 1; 15 mod 4 = 3, so the digit is 7.

questions.q: The average of five numbers is 24. If one of the numbers, 14, is removed, what is the average of the remaining four?
questions.exp: Sum = 5 x 24 = 120; remaining sum = 106; average = 106/4 = 26.5.

questions.q: A car travels 180 km at 60 km/h and returns the same distance at 90 km/h. What is its average speed for the whole journey?
Which activity best develops the concept of area in Class VI before the formula is introduced?
options: Telling learners to memorise length x breadth
Covering shapes with unit square tiles or counting squares on grid paper
Asking learners to copy formulas from the board
Giving a test on area formulas
questions.exp: Counting unit squares builds meaning of area; formulas then emerge from patterns.

questions.q: A Class VI student writes 3/4 + 2/5 = 5/9. What misconception does this error most likely show, and what should the teacher infer?
options: The student adds numerators and denominators separately and does not grasp the need for a common denominator
The student has not memorised the multiplication tables
The student is careless and has no misconception
questions.exp: Adding top and bottom separately is a classic conceptual error; diagnosing it guides remedial teaching.

questions.q: What is the simple interest on Rs 4000 at 7.5% per annum for 3 years?
The average of 11 numbers is 50. The average of the first six is 49 and that of the last six is 52. What is the sixth number?
A father is 3 times as old as his son. After 12 years he will be twice as old as his son. What is the son's present age?
questions.exp: Let son = x: 3x + 12 = 2(x + 12) gives x = 12.

questions.q: In a group of 100 people, 60 speak Hindi, 45 speak English and 20 speak both. How many speak exactly one of the two languages?
questions.exp: Only Hindi = 40, only English = 25; exactly one = 65.

questions.q: Statement I: Whole numbers include zero. Statement II: In the NCERT convention, natural numbers include zero. Which is correct?
options: Statement I is false and Statement II is true
Statement I is true and Statement II is false
questions.exp: Whole numbers = 0, 1, 2, ...; natural (counting) numbers start at 1 in the school convention.

questions.q: What is the mean proportional between 4 and 25?
questions.exp: Mean proportional = √(4 x 25) = 10.

questions.q: What is the area of a trapezium whose parallel sides are 10 cm and 14 cm and whose height is 8 cm?
The circumference of a circle is 44 cm. What is its area? (take π = 22/7)
questions.exp: 2πr = 44 gives r = 7 cm; area = πr² = 22/7 x 49 = 154 cm².

questions.q: Two articles are sold at Rs 990 each, one at 10% gain and the other at 10% loss. What is the overall result?
At what rate of simple interest per annum will a sum of money double itself in 8 years?
questions.exp: SI = P, so P x R x 8 / 100 = P gives R = 12.5%.

questions.q: If the cost price of 15 articles equals the selling price of 12 articles, what is the profit percent?
questions.exp: 15 C = 12 S gives S = 1.25 C, so profit = 25%.

questions.q: What is the average of the first 10 even natural numbers?
12 men can complete a work in 20 days. How many days will 15 men take?
questions.exp: Work = 12 x 20 = 240 man-days; 240/15 = 16 days.

questions.q: A can finish a job in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.exp: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36 per day, so time = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

questions.q: If n(A) = 40, n(B) = 35 and n(A ∪ B) = 60, what is n(A ∩ B)?
A shop sold 120, 150, 90 and 140 units in four consecutive months. What is the average monthly sale?
The volume of a cube is 343 cm³. What is its total surface area?
questions.exp: Side = 7 cm; surface area = 6 x 49 = 294 cm².

questions.q: Three bells ring at intervals of 6, 8 and 12 minutes. If they ring together at 9:00 a.m., when will they next ring together?
questions.exp: LCM of 6, 8, 12 = 24 minutes, so the next common ring is at 9:24 a.m.
